abstract.t: The purpose of this RFC is to announce a cancellation of the Resource Notebook Framework meeting that had tentatively been scheduled for March 19, 1973. (Please refer to NWG/RFC #464 (NIC #14738) for background information).
Further information concerning the Resource Notebook Framework that was discussed in RFC #464 will be distributed soon.
If there are any questions please contact either Jake Feinler or Mike Kudlick at the NIC, (415) 326-6200.
